files.content:
replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
data="{output}/test-data"
content=Oblivion.esm
content=m11-test.omwscripts
start=AnvilHorseWhisperer::ref=0x4e9a4::side=east
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"

[Video]
resolution x = 1280
resolution y = 720
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[Models]
load unsupported nif files = true
[Shaders]
force shaders = true
[Sound]
master volume = 1.0
voice volume = 1.0
[General]
screenshot format = png

local core = require('openmw.core')
local types = require('openmw.types')
local world = require('openmw.world')

local actorFoundAt
local played = false
local function onUpdate()
    if played then return end
    local player = world.players[1]
    for _, actor in pairs(world.activeActors) do
        if actor ~= player and types.ESM4NPC.objectIsInstance(actor) then
            actorFoundAt = actorFoundAt or core.getSimulationTime()
            if core.getSimulationTime() - actorFoundAt >= 7.5 then
                core.sound.say('sound/voice/oblivion.esm/redguard/m/charactergen_chargenvoice_0001e8d3_1.mp3', actor)
                played = true
            end
            return
        end
    end
end

return {{ engineHandlers = {{ onUpdate = onUpdate }} }}
